Day 23/90 Go: the channel send that hung forever.

```go
ch := make(chan int)
ch <- 42
fmt.Println(<-ch)
```

Output: fatal error: all goroutines are asleep - deadlock!

An unbuffered channel has zero capacity. The send is a synchronous handoff -- it blocks until a receiver is ready. My only receiver sat on the next line, but main was parked on the send and could never reach it.

Fix: send from another goroutine, or buffer the channel so the value gets a slot.
